options.content:
Ziel: Sichtbar machen, wie sich Abendspitzen waehrend der Hitzewelle im Vergleich zu den Nicht-Hitzewellenzeiten im Juni veraendert haben.

Hauptmessage: Der Abendstress entsteht, wenn PV auslaeuft, Residual-Last und Rampen steigen und Wind die Last nicht ausreichend deckt; die Muster unterscheiden sich je Land und sind in Preis, Timing, Windanteil und Residual-Last gleichzeitig sichtbar.

**Datenbasis:** Datenfluss: Rohdaten wurden mit `scripts/research_heatwave_2026.py` aus ENTSO-E Transparency, Energy-Charts/SMARD-Fallback fuer DE_LU-Preise und Open-Meteo geladen. Preise bleiben als `prices_qh` in 15-Minuten-Aufloesung erhalten; Last, Erzeugung, Fluesse und Wetter werden als Stundenkontext in `Europe/Brussels` normalisiert, als CSV gecacht und mit `scripts/load_heatwave_2026_to_postgres.py` in das OEDS-Postgres-Schema `heatwave_2026` geladen. Grafana fragt diese Tabellen direkt per SQL ab; Zeitbereich und Variablen werden live in der Query angewendet. Standard-Zeitfenster: 2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-30 23:00 Europe/Brussels; Hitzewellenfenster: 2026-06-13 00:00 bis 2026-06-29 23:00 Europe/Brussels; Baseline fuer voraggregierte Delta-Metriken: 2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-12 23:00 Europe/Brussels.

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.prices_qh`. Berechnung live in SQL: 15-Minuten-Werte in den lokalen Stunden 16:00-23:45 werden in Hitzewelle (2026-06-13 00:00 bis 2026-06-29 23:00 Europe/Brussels) und Nicht-Hitzewelle im ausgewaehlten Zeitbereich getrennt und je Stunde/Land gemittelt. Die x-Achse ist ein kuenstliches Tagesprofil; die Werte bleiben echte Day-ahead-Preise.

targets.rawSql:
WITH labelled AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::int AS hour_of_day,
        price_eur_mwh,
        CASE
            WHEN timestamp >= timestamptz '2026-06-13 00:00:00+02'
             AND timestamp < timestamptz '2026-06-30 00:00:00+02'
            THEN 'heatwave'
            ELSE 'non-heatwave'
        END AS period
    FROM heatwave_2026.prices_qh
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${price_country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 16 AND 23
)
SELECT make_timestamptz(2026, 6, 1, hour_of_day, 0, 0, 'Europe/Brussels') AS time,
       country || ' ' || period AS metric,
       avg(price_eur_mwh) AS value
FROM labelled
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Daily evening peak price

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.prices_qh`. Berechnung live in SQL: Tagesmittel der 15-Minuten-Preise 18:00-22:45 minus Tagesmittel 11:00-15:45. Positive Werte zeigen, dass der Abend gegenueber der PV-/Mittagsphase teurer wurde.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_avg_eur_mwh,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 15) AS midday_avg_eur_mwh
    FROM heatwave_2026.prices_qh
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${price_country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels' AS time,
       country || ' evening premium EUR/MWh' AS metric,
       evening_avg_eur_mwh - midday_avg_eur_mwh AS value
FROM daily
WHERE evening_avg_eur_mwh IS NOT NULL
  AND midday_avg_eur_mwh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Evening premium over midday

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.prices_qh`. Berechnung live in SQL: pro Tag/Land wird innerhalb 16:00-23:45 die Viertelstunde des hoechsten Day-ahead-Preises gesucht. Das zeigt, ob sich die Preismaxima spaeter oder frueher ballen.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        (
            extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')
          + extract(minute from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') / 60.0
        ) AS peak_time_decimal,
        price_eur_mwh,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date, country
            ORDER BY price_eur_mwh DESC NULLS LAST, timestamp DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM heatwave_2026.prices_qh
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${price_country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 16 AND 23
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels' AS time,
       country || ' evening peak time' AS metric,
       peak_time_decimal AS value
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Evening peak timing

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.mix_h`. Residual-Last = Last minus Solar minus Wind_total aus ENTSO-E-Last und Erzeugung. Berechnung live in SQL: lokales Stundenprofil 00:00-23:00 fuer FR, DE_LU, BE, NL, ES und IT_NORD. Verglichen werden Hitzewelle 13.-29.06. und Non-Heatwave-Baseline 01.-12.06.; 30.06. fliesst hier nicht ein.

targets.rawSql:
WITH labelled AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::int AS hour_of_day,
        residual_load_mw,
        CASE
            WHEN timestamp >= timestamptz '2026-06-13 00:00:00+02'
             AND timestamp < timestamptz '2026-06-30 00:00:00+02'
            THEN 'heatwave'
            ELSE 'non-heatwave'
        END AS period
    FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${country:sqlstring})
      AND country IN ('FR','DE_LU','BE','NL','ES','IT_NORD')
      AND timestamp >= timestamptz '2026-06-01 00:00:00+02'
      AND timestamp < timestamptz '2026-06-30 00:00:00+02'
)
SELECT make_timestamptz(2026, 6, 1, hour_of_day, 0, 0, 'Europe/Brussels') AS time,
       country || ' ' || period AS metric,
       avg(residual_load_mw) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM labelled
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.daily_ramps`. Berechnung je Tag und Land: Maximum Residual-Last 18:00-22:00 minus Minimum Residual-Last 11:00-15:00. Residual-Last stammt aus `mix_h` und ist Last minus Solar minus Wind_total.

FROM heatwave_2026.daily_ramps
WHERE date >= ($__timeFrom()::date)
  AND date < ($__timeTo()::date)

panels.title: Evening wind/load share

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.prices_qh`. Berechnung live in SQL: erst Tagespraemie Abend minus Mittag, dann Mittelwert Hitzewelle minus Mittelwert Nicht-Hitzewelle. Diese Balken zeigen die Aenderung der Abendpraemie je Land.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_avg_eur_mwh,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 15) AS midday_avg_eur_mwh
    FROM heatwave_2026.prices_qh
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${price_country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
labelled AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        CASE
            WHEN day >= date '2026-06-13' AND day < date '2026-06-30'
            THEN 'heatwave'
            ELSE 'non_heatwave'
        END AS period,
        evening_avg_eur_mwh - midday_avg_eur_mwh AS evening_premium_eur_mwh
    FROM daily
    WHERE evening_avg_eur_mwh IS NOT NULL
      AND midday_avg_eur_mwh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT country AS label,
       avg(evening_premium_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave') AS non_heatwave_premium_eur_mwh,
       avg(evening_premium_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave') AS heatwave_premium_eur_mwh,
       (
           avg(evening_premium_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave')
         - avg(evening_premium_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave')
       ) AS delta_heatwave_minus_non_heatwave_eur_mwh
FROM labelled
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY delta_heatwave_minus_non_heatwave_eur_mwh DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Evening premium delta by country

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.daily_ramps`. Berechnung je Tag aus `mix_h`: max Residual-Last 18:00-22:00 minus min Residual-Last 11:00-15:00. Das Panel vergleicht Hitzewelle mit Nicht-Hitzewelle im gewaehlten Zeitbereich.

targets.rawSql:
WITH labelled AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        CASE
            WHEN date >= date '2026-06-13' AND date < date '2026-06-30'
            THEN 'heatwave'
            ELSE 'non_heatwave'
        END AS period,
        evening_ramp_mw
    FROM heatwave_2026.daily_ramps
    WHERE date >= ($__timeFrom()::date)
      AND date < ($__timeTo()::date)
      AND country IN (${country:sqlstring})
)
SELECT country AS label,
       avg(evening_ramp_mw) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave') / 1000.0 AS non_heatwave_ramp_gw,
       avg(evening_ramp_mw) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave') / 1000.0 AS heatwave_ramp_gw,
       (
           avg(evening_ramp_mw) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave')
         - avg(evening_ramp_mw) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave')
       ) / 1000.0 AS delta_heatwave_minus_non_heatwave_gw
FROM labelled
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY delta_heatwave_minus_non_heatwave_gw DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Evening residual ramp delta

panels.description: Quellen: `heatwave_2026.prices_qh` und `heatwave_2026.mix_h`. Berechnung live in SQL: Tageswerte fuer Abendpreismaximum, Abendpraemie, Wind/Last-Anteil und Residual-Last werden nach Land/Tag verbunden. Tabelle fuer Plausibilitaet und Detailauswahl.

targets.rawSql:
WITH price_daily AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        max(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_peak_eur_mwh,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_avg_eur_mwh,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 15) AS midday_avg_eur_mwh
    FROM heatwave_2026.prices_qh
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${price_country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
mix_daily AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        avg(wind_total_mw) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_wind_avg_mw,
        avg(load_mw) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_load_avg_mw,
        avg(residual_load_mw) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_residual_avg_mw
    FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    p.day,
    p.country,
    CASE
        WHEN p.day >= date '2026-06-13' AND p.day < date '2026-06-30'
        THEN 'heatwave'
        ELSE 'non_heatwave'
    END AS period,
    round(p.evening_peak_eur_mwh::numeric, 1) AS evening_peak_eur_mwh,
    round((p.evening_avg_eur_mwh - p.midday_avg_eur_mwh)::numeric, 1) AS evening_premium_eur_mwh,
    round((m.evening_wind_avg_mw / NULLIF(m.evening_load_avg_mw, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS evening_wind_load_share_pct,
    round((m.evening_residual_avg_mw / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS evening_residual_avg_gw
FROM price_daily p
LEFT JOIN mix_daily m
  ON p.day = m.day AND p.country = m.country
ORDER BY p.day, p.country

panels.title: Evening wind-price context

panels.description: Quellen: `heatwave_2026.prices_qh`, `heatwave_2026.mix_h` und `heatwave_2026.daily_ramps`. Berechnung live in SQL: Hitzewellenmittel und Nicht-Hitzewellenmittel fuer Abendpreis, Abendpraemie, Residualrampe und Wind/Last-Anteil; Deltas zeigen die Veraenderung.

targets.rawSql:
WITH price_daily AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        max(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_peak_eur_mwh,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_avg_eur_mwh,
        avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 15) AS midday_avg_eur_mwh
    FROM heatwave_2026.prices_qh
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${price_country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 11 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
mix_daily AS (
    SELECT
        (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels')::date AS day,
        country,
        avg(wind_total_mw) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_wind_avg_mw,
        avg(load_mw) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22) AS evening_load_avg_mw
    FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND country IN (${country:sqlstring})
      AND extract(hour from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Brussels') BETWEEN 18 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ramp_daily AS (
    SELECT date AS day, country, evening_ramp_mw
    FROM heatwave_2026.daily_ramps
    WHERE date >= ($__timeFrom()::date)
      AND date < ($__timeTo()::date)
      AND country IN (${country:sqlstring})
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        p.day,
        p.country,
        CASE
            WHEN p.day >= date '2026-06-13' AND p.day < date '2026-06-30'
            THEN 'heatwave'
            ELSE 'non_heatwave'
        END AS period,
        p.evening_peak_eur_mwh,
        p.evening_avg_eur_mwh - p.midday_avg_eur_mwh AS evening_premium_eur_mwh,
        r.evening_ramp_mw,
        m.evening_wind_avg_mw / NULLIF(m.evening_load_avg_mw, 0) * 100 AS evening_wind_load_share_pct
    FROM price_daily p
    LEFT JOIN mix_daily m
      ON p.day = m.day AND p.country = m.country
    LEFT JOIN ramp_daily r
      ON p.day = r.day AND p.country = r.country
)
SELECT
    country AS label,
    round(avg(evening_peak_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave')::numeric, 1) AS non_heatwave_evening_peak_eur_mwh,
    round(avg(evening_peak_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave')::numeric, 1) AS heatwave_evening_peak_eur_mwh,
    round((avg(evening_peak_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave') - avg(evening_peak_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave'))::numeric, 1) AS delta_evening_peak_eur_mwh,
    round((avg(evening_premium_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave') - avg(evening_premium_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave'))::numeric, 1) AS delta_evening_premium_eur_mwh,
    round(((avg(evening_ramp_mw) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave') - avg(evening_ramp_mw) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave')) / 1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS delta_evening_ramp_gw,
    round((avg(evening_wind_load_share_pct) FILTER (WHERE period = 'heatwave') - avg(evening_wind_load_share_pct) FILTER (WHERE period = 'non_heatwave'))::numeric, 1) AS delta_evening_wind_load_share_pct
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY delta_evening_premium_eur_mwh DESC NULLS LAST
